id: # envpool: divergences the env pool's gates found: an env made with env_new (an image: test_interleave, test_relocate, the pool) replaying a tape, and the agent form (pool_gate --agent: a recording's own script) where a tape's resolved input hid them.

cause: collide_env_init set the chest and ladder constructor bounds of the current env, not the one being made: every env_new env had zero-size chest and ladder boxes (a bat flew through a dungeon chest at row 12; cov-villagerep-s42 w.bc row 225)
repro: make -C csrc/runtime -f pool.mk pool-gate RECS="s1chain-S8 cov-villagerep-s42" N=2 J=2

cause: the credits respawn (ServerConfigurationManager.respawnPlayer) sent an S09 with the server's slot, as syncPlayerInventory does; vanilla's addSelfToInternalCraftingInventory sends the window items and the cursor only, so the fresh client player keeps currentItem 0 (the tape's hb hid it; the script's agent acts show it at row 1297)

closing a container screen (client_close_screen) skipped displayGuiScreen(null)'s setIngameFocus: the focus stayed off (and the left click counter was not set to 10000), so an agent's attack after a close never dug (achieve-s1 row 666 in agent form: d.cseed); the tape's focus and lcc hid it
